the_sharpened_falsification: 1. UNOCCUPIED WINDOW (the evidential gap): the fit-side placements span E in {0, 600, 8800}; the window the current-gen holdouts demand (1002-1967 ns) lies between 600 and 8800 with NO fit-side anchor inside it — the fit set stages NO current-generation software/endpoint measurement (its only measured software-inclusive figure, GF-10, is V100-era DGX-1 app-level P2P; the current-gen decompositions live in HOLDOUT anchors, which the immutable split rightly forbids as fit inputs). The gap is no longer structural but EVIDENTIAL: it cannot be closed by model work, only by a new fit-side anchor (a future split's business, never this one)

2. RANGE-TOP CHALLENGE (the anchors disagree with each other): GF-01's RCCL eager collective floor demands implied E 9178-16339 ns — ABOVE the declared range upper 9000 that GF-10's own figure defines — while GF-11's NCCL leg demands 9797-10597 (also above). Across the corpus the software-inclusive magnitude spans ~10x (SoL 1.4 us to eager 16.7 us): a single uniform E with one range cannot serve RCCL-eager, stock-NCCL and near-optimal stacks simultaneously — the anchors demand a software-stack/generation AXIS on the endpoint term (the E-side sibling of S3's software-version axis), which the model still lacks

3. SHAPE DEMANDS UNCHANGED (carried): the lumped symmetric 2L + E cannot express GF-11's asymmetric decomposition (2x306 RTT + 792 store); the affine-plus-floor response cannot express GF-01's non-monotone eager band or a flat-then-rising transition; uniform E cannot express pair heterogeneity — all carried from S6 v1 unchanged by this term
cross_anchor_observations.what_the_term_earned: the model CLASS now reaches the measured current-generation small-message floor window (~1.0-2.0 us implied E): every near-optimal-leg and D2D implied value sits INSIDE the declared range [0, 9000] — where S4 v1 proved the wire-class axis could not reach the floor at ANY in-range placement, the endpoint-extended class can. The structural omission is FIXED
